transfer.automatic_approval_review: Rejected twice before execution. It classified this production database package as a sensitive external transfer and required exact payload-and-destination authorization in trusted user instructions despite the standing recovery goal and earlier approved destination evidence. No alternate route was used.

limits: The local recovery package is a complete verified checkpoint but not an independent off-site backup until exact transfer, download and restore pass.
Dependable unattended daily database operation and full application/Auth recovery remain unproven.
